questions: Did your right hand grasp the doctor’s hand without you intending to?
Did you feel unable to let go once you grasped the doctor’s hand?
Do you experience involuntary movements or posturing of the right arm when no one is touching it?
Did they begin after a head injury, stroke, seizure, or other neurological illness?
Do you have weakness or numbness on the right side of your body?
Have you had difficulty speaking, understanding speech, seeing, or walking?
Have you had episodes of loss of awareness, staring, or jerking movements?
Do you feel that the right hand is foreign or does things that you do not want it to do?
Can you voluntarily open and close the right hand when asked?
Are you currently taking sedatives, antipsychotic medicines, or other drugs that affect movement?
